node.statement: For x in l_inf^k, the hypothesis ||Upsilon Delta-I_B||_cb<=epsilon, isometry of iota, and contractivity of Upsilon give ||x||_inf=||iota x||<=||Upsilon Delta iota x||+epsilon||x||_inf<=||Delta iota x||+epsilon||x||_inf. Thus ||Delta iota x||>=(1-epsilon)||x||_inf.
